authorship: Reviewer did not author proposed neal_demo_v1 core/browser/bridge/wrapper files and made no edits to them. Final concrete source remains independently reviewable.
latest_scope_steering: Harness author relayed root freezes levels1,3,5 only. Historical plan lists1,3,5,9; final concrete manifest must state new3-level scope before execution, preserving this prior proposal.

required_dispositions.author_response: Harness author confirms fresh elements/local binding planned.
required_dispositions.requirement: Create a fresh iframe element/contentWindow each level, bind immutable local actor/session/level generation to it, listen before loading, accept exact origin/source/type only while that level is active, consume completion once, reject late/old-frame events. Never trust model done or fabricate game messages.
required_dispositions.risk: A reused iframe WindowProxy can survive navigation, so source+origin checks alone may admit a delayed completion from the prior level. Saved official message evidence does not show a payload session nonce.

required_dispositions.author_response: Harness author confirms no synchronized-native-start claim and timestamp retention planned.
required_dispositions.requirement: Never alter game timers or hidden state. Retain each actor navigation/load/ready/first-observation/first-action/completion times and include inference/render/bridge delays in actor end-to-end wall. Label any common harness start separately from native clock start.
required_dispositions.risk: No saved documented game pause/start API; loading both iframes and releasing actor loops is not proof of synchronized native game timers.

required_dispositions.requirement: Unpaired qualitative demo with one attempt per frozen level/actor; preserve initial screenshots and all failures/missing episodes. No reroll, best-of selection, replayed solution or SOTA/10x/general capability inference.
required_dispositions.risk: Same level URL is not identical randomized puzzle. Matching initial screenshot alone would also not prove matching future stochastic evolution.

required_dispositions.requirement: Label assistant+tooling honestly and use a trusted runtime model identifier only if available. Unknown assistant tokens/cost remain unknown, never zero. Report measured BU requests/tokens plus whole reserved/billed demo compute; do not invent cost ratios.
required_dispositions.risk: Interactive assistant model identity, hidden compute/token consumption and price are not supplied by the manual bridge. Common tools do not make reasoning/inference paths identical.

required_dispositions.requirement: Freeze device scale/viewport/frame dimensions and border policy; map iframe-local CSS pixels using actual current rectangle; reject outside-frame coordinates; serialize every physical mouse/keyboard action; verify actor frame/focus before dispatch; forbid shortcuts, navigation and cross-actor observations.
required_dispositions.risk: Border boxes, scaling, scrolling, transforms and shared keyboard focus can send an action to the wrong pane or coordinate.

required_dispositions.requirement: Revalidate queued visible element handles and focus/geometry immediately; declare coordinate semantics without claiming semantic target identity; discard unused suffix on terminal/error. Unknown command delivery is neither success nor proof of no effect and must not be retried.
required_dispositions.risk: Atomic structural batch validation does not prove later queued target identity or unchanged visual scene. Coordinates have no intrinsic element identity.

required_dispositions.requirement: Use explicit per-level success/failure/timeout/missing outcomes and planned denominator. Show successful completion time separately from failed elapsed/censored limits; no average-speed ratio over unequal solved subsets. Preserve native pending barriers even if game already completed.
required_dispositions.risk: Completed-only times bias a speed chart, and a native completion may arrive while generation or transport remains pending.

required_dispositions.requirement: Record raw continuous1x browser-only video with actor labels outside frames; preserve full original plus event timing. Do not fabricate cursor motion. Any action-marker overlay must be labelled as telemetry. Bound finalization/retrieval within reviewed lifecycle/storage; no extra invocation or reconstructed-video success claim after failure.
required_dispositions.risk: Playwright browser video may omit OS cursor; context.close finalization and artifact transfer can fail after gameplay.

required_dispositions.requirement: Freeze minimal actual required official asset origins, versions and final URLs after bounded CPU preflight; block popup/download/unrelated navigation. Separate interface validation from model outcomes, disclose prior task familiarity, and do not use outcomes to change levels/controls.
required_dispositions.risk: Missing fonts/assets or redirects can change task appearance or functionality; reference preflight can reveal task solutions.

required_dispositions.requirement: Only execute after root reconciles remaining shared30USD ceiling and reserves complete new lifecycle. This plan/review is not additional budget or provider execution permission.
required_dispositions.risk: GPU residency during manual actor delays, video finalization, CPU checks and artifact transfer also consumes resources.

saved_evidence_limit: Saved records describe official embed endpoint and captcha-completed message, but do not provide a documented deterministic seed, pause/start handshake, or echoed session/level nonce. No additional live source retrieval in this review.
scope: independent saved-plan and saved primary-source interpretation review only; no new site/provider/model call or package download
status: implementation constraints communicated to both authors; final new harness source and actual preflight still required
